headline: Uganda sets 500,000-tonne cocoa target in first ten-year strategy
summary: Uganda has launched its first national cocoa sector strategy, aiming to nearly sevenfold production over a decade and shift more processing and profit into the country. The plan targets $3 billion in annual exports by 2036.
why: Cocoa is a major soft commodity whose supply and processing shape global chocolate and confectionery costs. Export-led national strategies can alter future supply from smaller producers.
